title: round-<n>.answers.json
description: The fix skill's answers to one review round, in the package record (decision NF-012): one entry per kept finding of the round, each fixed or disputed. Unknown keys fail.

round.description: The review round answered, matching round-<n>.json.

head.description: The head the round reviewed (the head of round-<n>.json), as 40 hex digits, so the answers bind to the findings they answer.

answers.description: One answer per kept finding of the round; empty when the round kept none.

file.description: The finding's file, relative to the repository root.

line.description: The finding's line, or null when it had none.

rule.description: The rule the finding cited; empty for a general finding.

outcome.description: fixed: the code changed; disputed: the code stays, with a comment on the pull request.

note.description: What changed, or why the code stays.
